title: ERP System Development
shortDescription: End-to-end internal ERP system with complete technical lifecycle ownership — from architecture to deployment.
fullDescription: Leading the end-to-end development of an internal ERP system, owning the complete technical lifecycle from requirement analysis to implementation. Designed the overall system architecture, backend structure (MVC), and core business logic.
features: Complete system architecture with MVC pattern
Secure RESTful APIs for multiple ERP modules
JWT-based authentication with role-based access control
Database schema design with complex relationships
Data validation, error handling, and query optimization
challenges: Designing a flexible architecture to support multiple ERP modules
Implementing granular role-based access control across all endpoints
Optimizing database queries for large datasets

title: Institute Management System
shortDescription: Comprehensive institute management platform with RBAC supporting Student, Trainer, Admin, and Director roles.
fullDescription: Developed a comprehensive institute management platform with a secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system supporting Student, Trainer, Admin, and Director roles. End-to-end student lifecycle management with registration, approvals, assessments, and progress tracking.
features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) — Student, Trainer, Admin, Director
Student lifecycle: registration → approval → assessments → progress tracking
Trainer modules: attendance, leave, syllabus, batch management
Admin tools: course management, batch administration, certificate generation
Director dashboards: financials, payroll, syllabus approval, performance
challenges: Designing a multi-role system with granular permissions
Building complex approval workflows across multiple roles
